newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee closes down on dollar demand.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee closes down on dollar demand.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed down against the dollar on Thursday pushed by demand for the U.S. currency, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 56.78 to the dollar after opening at 56.71. Overnight call money closed at 13 percent with the market well offered, they said.
"Everybody seems to be liquid," a Commercial Bank dealer said. "People made use of this and bought dollars."
The Central Bank left the exchange rate unchanged. Buying and selling prices remained at 56.1305 and 57.2645.
